# Qualified presentation regression fixture

This repository-owned fixture supports presentation-export regression tests without shipping a runtime analysis run. It contains a minimal, current set of governed-format source, geometry-linkage, and validated-SaTScan interface/result records required to exercise the exporter software.

The fixture is a test authority only. It is not a scientific reporting run, is not an alternative publication output, and must not be interpreted as new study results. Tests materialise it temporarily under `out/runs/` and remove it after the test session.
